cve_summary: jpeg_size in pdfgen.c in PDFGen before 2018-04-09 has a heap-based buffer over-read.
commit_message:
jpeg: Fix another possible buffer overrun

Found via the clang libfuzzer
docstring:
"""
Summary: 
Determines the dimensions of a JPEG image from its binary data.

Parameters: 
data (unsigned char*): Pointer to the JPEG image data.
data_size (unsigned int): Size of the image data in bytes.
width (int*): Pointer to an integer where the width of the image will be stored.
height (int*): Pointer to an integer where the height of the image will be stored.

Returns: 
int: Returns 0 on success (dimensions stored in width and height), -1 on failure (invalid JPEG format or data).

Logic: 
The function checks if the provided data starts with the JPEG SOI marker and then looks for the JPEG header to extract the width and height. It iterates through the data, validating the JPEG structure and extracting the dimensions from the appropriate marker. If the JPEG format is invalid or the dimensions cannot be found, it returns -1.
